chapters.title: Graphical Representation of Functions
chapters.main_concept: Sketching and interpreting graphs of functions: quadratics from factor form, algebraic vs transcendental functions, exponential, hyperbolic/inverse hyperbolic, logarithmic and modulus functions, inverse functions as reflections in y = x, graph transformations (shifts and scaling), and solving/applying exponential and logarithmic equations and inequalities (growth/decay, decibels, compound interest).
learning_outcomes: Sketch a quadratic from its factorised form and predict a quadratic from its graph
Classify functions as algebraic or transcendental
State domain, range, intercepts, monotonicity, injectivity and asymptotes of exponential and logarithmic functions and sketch them
Define hyperbolic and inverse hyperbolic functions, prove identities and logarithmic forms, sketch sinh x and cosh x
Sketch the modulus function
Obtain the graph of an inverse function by reflection in y = x
Apply horizontal/vertical shifts and vertical/horizontal scaling to graphs
Solve exponential and logarithmic equations and inequalities with domain checks
Model growth/decay, sound level (decibels) and discrete/continuous compound interest

formulas: y = a(x-h)(x-k): x-intercepts h, k; vertex at x = (h+k)/2; y-intercept a*h*k
f(x) = a^x (a>0, a!=1): domain R, range (0,inf), y-intercept (0,1), asymptote y = 0; increasing if a>1, decreasing if 0<a<1
sinh x = (e^x - e^-x)/2, cosh x = (e^x + e^-x)/2, tanh x = sinh x/cosh x etc.
cosh^2 x - sinh^2 x = 1; 1 - tanh^2 x = sech^2 x; coth^2 x - 1 = csch^2 x; sinh 2x = 2 sinh x cosh x; cosh 2x = cosh^2 x + sinh^2 x
sinh^-1 x = ln(x + sqrt(x^2+1)); cosh^-1 x = ln(x + sqrt(x^2-1)), x>=1; tanh^-1 x = (1/2) ln((1+x)/(1-x)), |x|<1; coth^-1 x = (1/2) ln((x+1)/(x-1)), |x|>1; sech^-1 x, csch^-1 x log forms
y = log_a x <=> a^y = x; log_a(xy) = log_a x + log_a y; log_a(x/y) = log_a x - log_a y; log_a x^t = t log_a x; log_a x = log_b x / log_b a
Shift: y = f(x-h) + k; Scaling: y = a f(bx)
N = N0 e^(kt) (k>0 growth, k<0 decay)
A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt) (discrete); A = P e^(rt) (continuous)
